_comment: BannerForge design rules — based on IAB Display Advertising Guidelines, Google Display Ads best practices, and industry typography standards. Edit values here; the HTML reads these at runtime. Do not change key names without updating the HTML.

layout._comment: Safe-area padding as a fraction of the longest canvas dimension. IAB recommends at least 5% safe margin so content never bleeds to edge. 0.06 = 6%.
layout._comment_min: Absolute minimum padding in pixels regardless of ad size. Ensures tiny banners still have some breathing room.

headline._comment: All values control how the main headline is sized and placed.
headline._comment_scaleFactor: Headline font size = canvas width × scaleFactor. Google recommends text occupies no more than 30% of ad area. 0.07 gives readable but non-dominating text.
headline._comment_minPx: Absolute minimum font size in pixels. Below ~10px text is unreadable at standard screen DPI.
headline._comment_maxPx: Hard cap in pixels. IAB and Google both flag ads where headline text is excessively large relative to the ad — 44px is large enough for a 300×250 without overwhelming it.
headline._comment_maxLines: Maximum lines of headline text to render. More than 2 lines in a standard display ad creates clutter and reduces click intent.
headline._comment_lineHeightMultiplier: Line height = fontSize × this. 1.2 is tight but readable for bold display type.
headline._comment_yPositionFraction: Vertical position of headline as a fraction of canvas height. 0.28 places it in the upper-middle third — the primary viewing zone per F-pattern reading research.

narrow._comment: Rules for horizontal banners where height < width × narrowThreshold. These get single-line centred treatment.
narrow._comment_xFraction: Horizontal centre point as fraction of width — offset from left to leave room for logo.
narrow._comment_logoWidthFraction: Text max-width as fraction of canvas width in narrow mode, to avoid overlapping logo.

logo._comment: Logo sizing rules. IAB recommends logo is clearly visible but never the dominant element.
logo._comment_scaleFactor: Logo max-dimension = min(canvasW, canvasH) × scaleFactor. 0.22 gives a logo roughly 1/5 of the shortest side.
logo._comment_aspectRatio: Logo render height = logoSize × aspectRatio. Assumes typical horizontal logo proportions. User's actual image is always fitted inside this box.

narrow._comment: In narrow banners the logo is the primary brand element, so it gets more space.

smallPrint._comment: Legal / disclaimer text rules. Regulatory bodies (FCA, ASA, FTC) require small print to be legible — not invisible.
smallPrint._comment_zoneHeightFraction: Small print zone = canvas height × this. 0.15 = bottom 15% of the ad, which is standard for disclaimer placement.
smallPrint._comment_font: Small print uses a regular weight sans-serif. Bold would compete with headline.
smallPrint._comment_scaleFactorStart: Starting font size = canvasW × this before auto-shrink loop. 0.028 is a reasonable starting estimate.
smallPrint._comment_minPx: 7px is the regulatory floor — the ASA (UK) and FCA guidance both cite 6–7pt as minimum legible print in ads. Below this the text is considered unreadable and may breach advertising standards.
smallPrint._comment_maxPx: 11px prevents small print from becoming so large it competes with the headline.
smallPrint._comment_lineHeight: Small print line height multiplier. Slightly looser than headline to aid readability of dense legal text.
smallPrint._comment_bgAlpha: Opacity of dark background strip behind small print. Ensures contrast compliance (WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 ratio for normal text).
smallPrint._comment_textAlpha: Opacity of the small print text itself. 0.88 gives near-white on dark strip.
smallPrint._comment_textColor: Small print text colour. White on the dark strip satisfies contrast requirements.
smallPrint._comment_zonePaddingFraction: Vertical padding inside the zone as a fraction of zone height.

accentBar._comment: The coloured bar at the bottom of every ad — a brand/style element. Keep thin so it doesn't eat into small print zone.
accentBar._comment_heightPx: Height in pixels. 3px is a standard 'rule line' weight used in print and digital design.

contrastText._comment: Luminance threshold for choosing black vs white headline text over a solid background. 0.5 means: if background luminance > 50%, use dark text. Based on WCAG relative luminance formula.
